rule: Parse list cells with safe literal/JSON parsing; retain source field and exact span
abstention: Malformed list; role or negative/aspirational context
examples: Do not split C++ or titles destructively

rule: NFKC; BOM removal; casefold; whitespace/format punctuation normalization; preserve + # . - / & _
auto_accept_condition: Unique canonical target and full term
abstention: Normalized collision or token boundary mismatch

auto_accept_condition: Unique target with positive attributable user evidence
examples: Python exact official product if unique

rule: Versioned deterministic alias registry with human approval, source and rationale
auto_accept_condition: Explicit APPROVED alias and valid taxonomy version
examples: Python programming/Python 3; React.js/ReactJS; MS Excel/Microsoft Excel require verified reviewed entries

rule: Preserve raw product version and canonical parent link separately
abstention: Version changes semantic target or unsupported link
examples: Python 3 may map to parent only after documented policy

rule: Candidate retrieval only; never final mapping
abstention: Abstain pending human review; similarity is not confidence
examples: Do not match broad SQL to every SQL product

rule: Term boundaries plus section/span; detect negation, desire-to-learn, job quotations and role ambiguity
auto_accept_condition: Positive explicit mention with matching evidence
abstention: Unknown context or implied title-derived skill
examples: Learning Python is aspiration, not demonstrated usage

rule: Exact unambiguous then approved alias; unresolved alternatives remain visible
auto_accept_condition: No candidate override of an ambiguous exact match
abstention: Reason code and candidate list retained
